heroLabel: A little clarity goes a long way
heroTitle: A clearer path to your next chapter.
heroBody: Make sense of money, school and settling into life in BC. Choose what matters to you. Leave with a plan you can use.
heroAside: You don’t have to figure it all out.
heroAsideBody: Official information. Small, practical steps. Room for the questions you still have.

offlineExplanation: Offline preparation guide. Online conversation is awaiting secure setup and verification.
onlineAvailable: Optional AI conversation is available on this server.
consentTitle: Choose how you want to work
consentBody: Online conversation sends your message, selected details and recent conversation to OpenAI. VERA keeps an encrypted temporary session for up to one hour of inactivity; Clear session removes it from the active database. Expired sessions are inaccessible and purged on the next request. Hosting backups and provider retention may apply. Do not enter names, ID numbers, account details or passwords. Enquiries are never sent automatically.
confirmHelp: Confirm the topics and any suggested details. Skip anything you’re unsure about. A suggestion is not treated as a fact until you confirm it.
moreDetails: Optional details for a more useful enquiry

reasons.facts_changed: Your answers changed. Review the updated step and any personal edits.
reasons.source_changed: The source record changed. Check the revised guidance before using this step.
reasons.source_stale: The source needs a new check. Use the official page to confirm current instructions.
reasons.route_removed: This route no longer matches the selected details. Your previous work is kept for review.

enquiryHelp: Choose a destination, edit the message, then contact the organization yourself.
copyFailed: Clipboard unavailable. Select and copy the text, or download your plan.
notesPlaceholder: Keep useful questions or reminders here. Avoid sensitive details.
exportHelp: These downloads include your goal, selected details, tasks, edits, enquiries and notes. Review them below first. JSON lets you resume later; it does not save AI consent or chat history.
importHelp: Only a VERA version 2 JSON plan is accepted (100 KB maximum). It is read locally. We recheck its source versions and age; we do not fetch fresh government pages during import.
importDone: Plan resumed. Review any flagged steps; AI remains off.
invalid_import: That file is not a valid VERA version 2 plan. No data was imported.
sourceTitle: Know where your next step comes from.
sourceHelp: Curated summaries of official sources. Open the publisher’s page for complete conditions and current details.
sourceReview: Automated source inspection; independent policy review pending
translationNote: French UI and summaries are AI-drafted and have not had human language review. Official French pages are linked where available.
sourceVersionNote: This identifies VERA’s curated summary, not a captured full government document.
unavailable: A source could not be loaded. Use the official page to confirm details.
boundary: Preparation guidance, not an eligibility decision, tax filing or payment estimate. Official programs make the final decision.
aboutIntro: VERA helps newcomers across British Columbia turn official financial and settlement information into a practical plan. Students are one part of the audience.
coverageBody: Settlement, student funding, banking basics, newcomer tax preparation and a small benefit catalog. Institution-specific records cover SFU and UBC Vancouver. Other institutions and campuses receive a scoped handoff. No appointments, bank accounts or applications are created.
privacyBody: Offline guidance stays in this tab unless you export it. Online conversation requires consent and sends selected context to OpenAI. Its temporary encrypted session expires after one hour of inactivity; clear it when finished. Downloaded files remain under your control. No profiles are silently saved in browser storage. Hosting backups and provider retention may apply.
statusBody: The online backend uses the configured OpenAI model and becomes available only after a real setup test. Offline guidance remains available. All eight inherited eligibility rules remain drafts. No participant study or independent policy review has been completed.
attributionBody: VERA builds on Diya Giri’s repository and preserves Kopal Chaudhary’s inherited prototype in baseline/. This independent project is not endorsed by the listed programs.
slidesNote: Open the 10-minute project presentation. The deck describes the release at the time it was prepared; current implementation status is in the repository.
footerNote: An independent prototype for British Columbia.
clearHelp: This clears the current page and any active API session. Download first if you want to keep your plan.
chatHelp: AI can explain retrieved evidence and suggest facts for you to confirm. It cannot approve access or submit anything.
aiError: AI could not complete a grounded answer. Your plan is preserved. You can continue with offline guidance.
error: Something went wrong. Your existing plan is still here.
stale_version: Your plan changed. Refresh the current server state before retrying.
review_required: Review the changed step before marking it complete.
official_review_needed: This step needs current official confirmation.
remove_identifiers: Remove ID numbers, account numbers or other sensitive identifiers before continuing.
noResults: Choose your topics to create a plan.
enquiryChanged: Details changed. Review your message before using it.
outOfBC: This catalog focuses on BC. Provincial and institution-specific routes are hidden for other provinces. Use the federal resources to find the right local destination.
noMatch: I couldn’t match that goal confidently. Choose the topics you want to explore.
importPreview: Review before replacing your current plan
session_expired: The API session expired. Your browser plan is preserved. Switch to offline guidance or start a new AI session.
confirmTogether: Confirm these details together. You can change them now or later.
conversationIntro: Tell us what matters. We’ll keep your needs together and ask only what helps.
request_cancelled: The request stopped. Your previous plan is safe. Retry the same message to check its result without duplicating the request.
incomplete_response: The AI response was incomplete. Your previous plan is unchanged; try a shorter request.
provider_refusal: The model could not answer this request. Try describing the preparation help you need, or use offline guidance.
provider_timeout: The AI service took too long. Your previous plan is safe. Please retry later.
invalid_api_key: Online AI needs an owner configuration update. You can use offline guidance.
model_access: The configured model is unavailable to this API account. The owner needs to check access.
quota_exhausted: The site’s AI quota is exhausted. Please use offline guidance or return later.
provider_rate_limit: The AI service is busy. Please retry later; your plan is preserved.
turn_in_progress: Your previous request is still running. Please wait before retrying.
index_not_ready: Evidence search is awaiting owner setup. Offline guidance remains available.
